calculation.description: Signed 20-trading-day price displacement divided by the total absolute daily path over the same window. Higher values identify persistent upward trends; lower values identify persistent downward trends. All inputs are lagged through the prior completed session at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Passed full-history benchmark gates. IC was positive in 2020-2022 and 2025-2026 pre-online samples, but materially negative during the 2026-07-16 through 2027-02-25 online slice (IC -0.1155, ICIR -0.4291); use conservatively and monitor drift.
